desc: Read N, M and string S from stdin.
Convert S characters to integer codes 0-25.
Precompute transition table next_mask[mask][c] for mask in [0, 2^N) and c in [0, 26) using the LCS DP on a row array.
Initialize dp array of size 2^N with dp[0]=1 and others 0 modulo MOD.
Repeat M times: for each mask, distribute dp[mask] to dp[next_mask[mask][c]] for all 26 characters.
For each k=0..N, sum dp[mask] over masks with popcount(mask)==k to get ans_k.
Print ans_0 ans_1 ... ans_N separated by spaces.
